messages:
Sam Park: quick heads-up — Siemens EdgeBench run finished this morning. raw numbers posted by benchbot below. need alignment on kernel handoff, perf/W targets, and marketplace bundle timeline. @Maria @Derek @Jen?
benchbot: automated report uploaded: https://files.redwood/siemens-edgebench/5234/report.html :robot_face:
benchbot: summary: p99 latency 28ms, sustained throughput 4200 req/min, normalized perf/W 5.9 tokens/s/W (quant = int8-fp16 hybrid).
Maria Ortiz: nice. is perf/W measured at steady state or includes warmup?
benchbot: perf/W is steady-state after 2-minute ramp.
Derek Li: looked at the trace — KV cache hotpath is adding ~6% CPU on the partner firmware. I have a kernel tweak that drops that by ~4% and improves perf/W to ~6.1 tokens/s/W on our rig. patch below.
Derek Li: ```
// small delta to scheduling and page-alignment for mmap
diff --git a/infer/kernel/sched.c b/infer/kernel/sched.c
+    if (align_pages) {
+        prefetch_align(pages, PAGE_2M);
+    }
```
Derek Li: need Siemens team to apply the same civlib flags (ENABLE_KV_PREFETCH=1) in their runtime build.
Maria Ortiz: thanks. can we get a quick A/B: quant=int8 vs int8-fp16 hybrid? want to confirm quality delta before we suggest partner ship-in change.
benchbot: ab sweep queued: job 8273 (int8), job 8274 (int8-fp16). ETA 3h.
Jen Huang: from GTM: if we land the kernel patch + hybrid quant we can aim for a joint marketplace listing next month. need a 2-week validation window and partner sign-off on legal/comms. can engineering estimate time to validate canary?
Derek Li: 2 business days for internal validation once patches applied, then we need Siemens CI to run the acceptance matrix (should be 3 days). so ~5 working days total.
Sam Park: ok — plan proposal:
- Day 0: share kernel patch + build flags with Siemens (this thread)
- Day 1-3: Siemens applies patch and runs partner CI matrix (we provide scripts)
- Day 4-5: Redwood internal validation + perf regressions check
- Day 6: sign-off meeting and kickoff marketplace listing asset handoff (PR, benchmarks, media)
Sam Park: @Jen can you draft a one-pager for the marketplace listing that includes the perf/W claims and sample configs? we should avoid absolute language — use "typical" and link to the full report. :memo:
Jen Huang: on it. will share draft by EOD PT. will include callouts for test config, model & sequence length, and quantization settings.
Maria Ortiz: note — we should also capture eval prompts where int8 dropped >2% quality for a specific prompt bucket. I'll generate a small regression set and add to the report.
Derek Li: also flag: if partner firmware can't set ENABLE_KV_PREFETCH, fallback policy should route to a slightly larger instance size to maintain p99. we'll add that to rollout runbook.
Sam Park: perfect. action items: Sam -> share patch + scripts (today), Derek -> run internal canary (tomorrow), Maria -> regression set (48h), Jen -> marketplace one-pager (EOD). Siemens contact (cc'd off-thread) will ack.
Jen Huang: tagging legal to review co-marketing language once draft is ready. :eyes:
Sam Park: thanks everyone. we'll reconvene after benchbot finishes the ab sweep. :thumbsup:
